text:
maya: Heads-up, design review today at 11 about model catalog compare. Quick pre-read: persistent pin visibility is biting us on collapsed rows. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123/model-catalog-compare-v2 :mag:

 tom: Saw that. When rows collapse the badges (perf/cost) vanish and the pin icon goes with them. Users who pin a version lose sight of it.

 eli: Two quick fixes: 1) move pin to left gutter so it survives collapse 2) show a tiny chip inline with model name when collapsed (e.g., "Pinned v2"). I prefer the chip for clarity.

 anna: Chip is clearer but might break localization width. Left gutter is safer for i18n. Also need to ensure focus order doesn't skip the pin.

 maya: Accessibility aside, also thinking about density. Our compare table is used with many rows; a sticky header with pinned items could cover too much. Proposal: hybrid behavior: inline gutter pin for <=2 pins, sticky compact bar for 3+.

 tom: Hybrid seems reasonable. UX question: should pinning change filter state? If I pin then apply a filter that excludes it, do we hide the pinned model? I think we should offer an option: "Keep pinned rows visible" toggle.

 eli: Agreed. Quick mock interaction: when toggled, pinned rows are promoted to the top and highlighted. Simple keyboard path: press P while the row is focused to toggle pin. Add aria-label="Toggle pin for compare".

 anna: Accessibility nits: performance badge uses low-contrast green. Fails 4.5:1 at 12px. Fix options: darker fill, outline, or append short text like "Low latency" on hover. Also badges need role="img" + aria-label describing metric.

 maya: Microcopy: change tooltip from "Pin version" to "Pin model for side-by-side compare". Avoid the word "version" unless it's a build number.

 tom: Also found a dev constraint: moving the icon to the gutter requires adjusting table cell padding and could break selection drag. Consider overlay layer to keep DOM minimal.

 eli: For keyboard, implement aria-pressed on the button and accept Space/Enter. Example:

```
<button class="cmp-pin" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Toggle pin for compare">📌</button>
```

 anna: Small behavior ask: pinned models should retain their selected model variant even if the global compare model changes. Otherwise pin loses meaning.

 maya: I'll prototype two variants: (A) gutter pin + inline chip for collapsed rows (B) gutter pin + optional compact sticky row. Will demo both. Aim to land accessibility fixes in the same PR.

 ui-bot: Created ticket PC-4721: "Compare: pin visibility + a11y + pinned-row persistence" and attached prototypes.

 product-ops: Added ACs and assigned to eng-frontend. Please include keyboard flows and contrast checks.

 tom: Perfect. Thanks—I'll queue a quick accessibility review with ANa by EOD. :thumbsup:

 maya: Thanks team—see you at the design review.
